address: 5B, Four Seasons Hotel, 145 Jalan Ampang, Kuala Lumpur, Kuala Lumpur, 50450, Malaysia
bio: Set under high ceilings, this remarkable dining room with nice views is a great choice for both casual and formal gatherings. A specialist in Cantonese cuisine, the chef has lived in Southeast Asia for many years. His concise menu is pork free with a quality selection of seafood and dim sum. Don’t miss the daily Inspirational Soup or fresh prawns simmered with glass noodles. Wrap up your meal with a crispy red bean pancake. The signature duck must be ordered in advance....
